strategy_roster.name: VWAP Mean Magnet v2 (Volume Filter)
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < sma((high + low + close) / 3, 60) and rsi(close, 14) < 25 and volume_ratio(volume, 20) > 3
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP is approximated by the 60-bar typical-price average and the documented volume filter by volume_ratio(20) above the documented multiplier 3, with RSI oversold 25. The documented Stop loss 0.5% is applied; exit is the documented return to VWAP.

strategy_roster.name: CCI and Martin
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so the documented short bearish sequence confirmed by the oscillator is approximated by a three-bar decline with RSI(14) oversold. CciPeriod has no documented value, and martingale scaling, pip stops and the trailing stop are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Well Martin
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < bb_lower(close, 20) and adx(high, low, close, 14) < 25
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long rule (break below the lower Bollinger band while trend strength is low) is kept, with a Bollinger period of 20, ADX period 14 and ADX level 25 as explicit defaults. BollingerWidth, AdxLevel values and the price-unit stop and target are not documented as percentages.

strategy_roster.name: OzFx Simple
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close, 5) > 50 and close > ema((high + low) / 2, 5) - ema((high + low) / 2, 34)
strategy_roster.exit_long: rsi(close, 5) < 50 or close < ema((high + low) / 2, 5) - ema((high + low) / 2, 34)
strategy_roster.notes: The Accelerator/Decelerator oscillator is approximated by the 5/34 median-price EMA difference and the stochastic %K by RSI with the documented StochasticLevel 50 and StochasticLength 5. Stacking five market orders with staggered take-profits and break-even, plus pip distances, cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Vector3
strategy_roster.notes: Direct translation of the documented three-MA alignment with the documented lengths 10/50/100 and the opposite signal as exit. Docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: HistoryInfoEaStrategy
strategy_roster.notes: This is a trade-history statistics reporter that never registers its own orders, so there is no market-derived entry to translate. A never-true guard is used; the magic number, comment and security filters are reporting options.

strategy_roster.name: Chart Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: The default Stochastic choice is approximated by RSI(14) with a 3-period signal line and the documented Oversold 20 / Overbought 80 zones, keeping the bullish crossover near oversold as the long entry. The documented StopLossPercent 2.0 is applied; MFI/RSI selector modes are not modelled.

strategy_roster.name: S&P 100 Option Expiration Week
strategy_roster.notes: Entry and exit depend purely on calendar events (Monday of the option-expiry week and the third Friday), with no market-derived signal and no indicators. A never-true guard is used because the DSL has no date or session fields.

strategy_roster.name: Limits Bot
strategy_roster.notes: The bot brackets each candle open with symmetric limit orders at fixed price-step distances, so the entry is an order-placement offset rather than a market signal. A never-true guard is used; the documented point offsets and session window are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: DCA Strategy 2
strategy_roster.notes: crossabove(close, open) is the closest proxy for a green Heikin Ashi candle following a red one. Exit RSI has no documented value (40 used) and the Start Year / End Year window plus partial-close percentage cannot be expressed.
